test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In the following triads, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one which follows the same logic.

GATE - ETGA - GTAE

PRAY - YAPR - PARY
solution:
**Given Triads:**

GATE → ETGA → GTAE

PRAY → YAPR → PARY

**Observe the pattern:**

**GATE → ETGA**

From the first word:Last two letters come first in reverse.First two letters move to the end

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f4e0d0e72b0c70d0ce286899984278ef8d22f0d1247ecf59047df35ae94fc3c.png] 

ETGA → GTAE

3rd and 1st letters comes first.4th and 2nd letters comes then

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19061763fe86a9a7b41eeb6986926ad3494de9e84713eee351c8a3aaff0421c6.png] 

**Check the options:**

**Option 2:** USER - REUS - UESR

(RE) + (US) = REUS 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a856f9b7e2b9f95a1dc05e4f213f6444bf534f5db5801fd36830423c5a87723.png] 

Now,

REUS → UESR 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4401099fe2a2bcdcb9d023b02f6d7371526be75e897ad7e8315d450a86a9ea0d.png] 

So, this follows the same logic.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
